decisions.source: Table114 requires the field; §9.7.3 explicitly says it shall not be used to determine compatibility. #518 on physical p344 removes the alternate array shape for CMap-side CIDSystemInfo.
decisions.current_decision: Use Registry/Ordering to identify compatibility and collection mapping; do not compare Supplement as part of compatibility. Current code's collection_names behavior matches this.
decisions.residual: Keep separate from §9.7.5.2's processor-version/new-supplement no-display sentence; that branch has no reliable fixture provenance yet.

decisions.topic: Predefined CMap set and selected source data
decisions.source: §9.7.5.2 requires four specified character collections and Table116 lists predefined CMap names. Table117 is explicitly empty; its following prose is still normative.
decisions.current_decision: Count the pinned 239-map Adobe inventory and data/parser tests as support evidence; combine with a literal Type0 public mapping test. Do not infer support from Table117's empty rows.
decisions.support: ADR0140, predefined.rs tests, composite_font_fixtures.rs exact 90ms-RKSJ-H consumer.
decisions.residual: No all-name table transcription in CI. Pinned data hashes and complete-carried-map tests mitigate this, but do not assert independent full mapping equivalence.

decisions.source: Post-Table117 prose states CIDs introduced in a later supplement than the processor's corresponding supported PDF version are not displayed. Table117 says version information is in each collection's normative reference, not in this standard's table.
decisions.current_decision: Record as an unresolved source/data question, not a confirmed runtime failure. The runtime path is version-neutral, but no later-supplement CID has yet been independently identified from an authoritative held reference.
decisions.next_evidence_needed: Authoritative version-to-supplement mapping and at least one CID known to be added after the supported supplement; then valid embedded Type0 positive/control fixture.
decisions.no_test: Do not create a test using an invented CID/supplement assignment.

decisions.current_decision: Mark the prior test gap closed by current T129. Test is tracked, exact-xref, public Type0 page, exact inherited/override GIDs, actual outlines, and passed wave97/wave111. Do not duplicate ToUnicode or add another stream chain without a new source-backed feature.
related_adrs: ADR 0029, composite CMap and CID-to-glyph separation
